source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    side = r1 - r0 + 1
    ring_colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            depth = min(r-r0, r1-r, c-c0, c1-c)
            color = ring_colors[(depth - 1) % 4]
            if side == 9 and depth == 4:
                color = 0
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
def make_frame(h,w,r0,c0,r1,c1):
    a=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): a[r][c]=5
    return a
def expected_rings(inp, colors, side9_exception=False):
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    ps=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in ps);r1=max(r for r,c in ps);c0=min(c for r,c in ps);c1=max(c for r,c in ps)
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            d=min(r-r0,r1-r,c-c0,c1-c)
            if d in colors: out[r][c]=colors[d]
    return out
